matter_background.original: Anuk de Silva, Pramuk de Silva and Dinuk de Silva are three brothers and they own equal undivided shares of a divided portion of a land in extent of 45 perches as per a Partition Decree in the District Court of Ratnapura in case No. 345/P. Anuk wishes to sell his entitlement of the land. Pramuk wishes to construct a house on his share of the land having mortgaged it to a Bank. Dinuk wants to Lease his share of land to a Company for a commercial purpose. The Bank informed Pramuk that he should have a divided and defined block of land in order to enable them to grant him a loan. Therefore, he informs his brothers that they should file a Partition Action for the division of the property. Anuk has approached you for Legal advice.
